================================================================================
EASY CARS BIEL - 360° VIDEO SEQUENCE FRAME FOLDER
================================================================================
Vehicle: Audi A5 Sportback 3.0 TDI quattro S-Line (Pieterlen, Switzerland)
Target Directory: e:\car rental\public\assets\vehicles\audi-a5\360\

When you convert your video into an image sequence, drop the exported image files
into this folder.

RECOMMENDED NAMING CONVENTIONS:
------------------------------
Option A: Numbered Frames (36 or 72 frames)
  frame_01.jpg
  frame_02.jpg
  frame_03.jpg
  ...
  frame_36.jpg

Option B: Perspective Folders
  /public/assets/vehicles/audi-a5/360/exterior/
  /public/assets/vehicles/audi-a5/360/interior/
  /public/assets/vehicles/audi-a5/360/side/
  /public/assets/vehicles/audi-a5/360/back/

The interactive 360° player (Interactive360SequenceViewer.tsx) will automatically
detect and play your image sequence with smooth mouse and touch scrubbing!
